verdict: App-V app cannot stream from the DP because the client's proxy routes the request externally. Windows' proxy bypass does not treat FQDNs containing a dot as 'local', so the local-bypass flag does not cover the DP.
fix: Add the DP's FQDN to the `Do not use proxy server for addresses beginning with` list in the client proxy settings (GPO or manual). For example: add `myserver.contoso.com` as its own exclusion, not just the leaf name. Alternatively add the DP FQDN to the Local Address Table (LAT) on the upstream proxy. This is a Windows proxy quirk, not an App-V bug; any FQDN-addressed internal server needs the same treatment.
